project_info.theme: HSBC payment discount campaign on Shopee
project_info.color_palette: Shopee orange, HSBC red, deep blue, white, yellow

main_subject.detail: A bright bank-payment promo with Shopee and HSBC logos on top and the badge 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG'. A giant blue rounded header reads 'GIAM DEN 1.2 TRIEU DONG'. Below, a large smartphone held in a hand shows HSBC branding, with a smiling woman behind it on a red geometric shape. A floating running shoe and headphones appear above the phone, and a Shopee bag icon tile plus a blush compact sit near the bottom.
main_subject.style: Bold commercial banking-promo poster with lifestyle reward collage, oversized numerals, and bright retail energy

composition_elements.text: HSBC / NGAY 15 / SALE GIUA THANG / GIAM DEN 1.2 TRIEU DONG
items: Top Left: Shopee logo and HSBC logo
Top Right: White sale badge 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG'
Bottom Left: Blush compact and part of the smartphone/hand composition
Bottom Right: Shopee bag icon tile and white-orange headphones floating above
Center/Background: Large blue discount pill, big smartphone with HSBC branding, smiling woman behind it, and floating shopping reward items including a colorful sneaker

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Saturated colors, glossy device highlights, crisp floating object shadows, energetic clean finish

technical_specs.render_style: Payment-benefit poster with photo-composite lifestyle elements

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Shopee x HSBC payment promotion. Centerpiece is a giant smartphone with HSBC branding held in a hand, with a smiling woman behind it and floating shopping-reward items like a sneaker and headphones. Background is a Shopee-orange field with a large blue discount pill that reads 'GIAM DEN 1.2 TRIEU DONG'. Surrounding elements: Shopee and HSBC logos, white badge 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG', a Shopee bag icon tile, and a cosmetic compact. Technical style: payment-benefit poster with photo-composite lifestyle elements, bright retail-commercial lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
